dialogues.speaker: Moo
dialogues.text: Just what the heck is that!?

dialogues.speaker: Moo
dialogues.text: She's not a Saurian like us, she can breathe underwater, and she has two stubby horns.

dialogues.speaker: Moo
dialogues.text: She's also wearing clothes, and can speak the language of humans.

dialogues.speaker: Moo
dialogues.text: ...She also won't let me drink the hot spring water! But whyyyyyy!?
